notes.international_hybrid: Belhaven's international graduate support FAQ says it does not offer financial aid or scholarships for the international hybrid (CPT) programs. Contact gradinternational@belhaven.edu to confirm.
notes.stacking: Online institutional discounts and scholarships can't be combined.

awards.name: Distinguished Merit Scholarship
awards.criteria: High school GPA 3.5+, ACT 30+, and an interview with the Office of Admission. Competitive.
awards.renewal: Up to 5 years (10 semesters) with full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress

awards.name: President's Scholarship
awards.criteria: High school GPA 3.5+ and ACT 26+.
awards.renewal: Up to 5 years (10 semesters) with full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress

awards.name: Dean's Scholarship
awards.criteria: High school GPA 2.5+ and ACT 20+.
awards.renewal: Up to 5 years (10 semesters) with full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress

awards.name: Achievement Grant
awards.criteria: High school GPA 2.5+ and ACT 18-19.
awards.renewal: Up to 5 years (10 semesters) with full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress

awards.name: Advantage Scholarship
awards.criteria: High school GPA 2.75+; no test score required.
awards.renewal: Up to 5 years (10 semesters) with full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress

awards.name: Early Acceptance Award
awards.criteria: Apply by December 1 (decision by December 15).

awards.name: Phi Theta Kappa Transfer Scholarship
awards.criteria: Current member of the Phi Theta Kappa honor society.
awards.renewal: Up to 5 years (10 semesters) with full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress

awards.name: Transfer Scholarship
awards.criteria: 12+ college credit hours and college GPA 2.5+.
awards.renewal: Up to 5 years (10 semesters) with full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress

awards.name: Distinguished Arts Scholarship
awards.criteria: Majors in Art, Creative Writing, Dance, Graphic Design, Film Production, Music, Theatre or Tradigital Studies; audition or portfolio (early review by Dec 1, 2026; rolling through March 1, 2027).

awards.name: Residence Hall Grant
awards.criteria: Traditional undergraduates living on campus. Cannot be combined with tuition discounts, waivers, sponsorships or some Belhaven scholarships.

awards.name: Visit Scholarship
awards.criteria: Make a personal campus visit or attend a Discover Day.

awards.name: Legacy Scholarship
awards.criteria: Child or sibling of a current student or graduate.

awards.name: Church Matching Grant
awards.criteria: Belhaven matches a congregation's contribution for its members; application in BlazeNet.

awards.name: Presbyterian Scholarship Program
awards.criteria: Member of a Presbyterian church, traditional full-time student; church donates at least $1,000 per year to the Belhaven fund.

awards.name: PCA Pastor's Offer
awards.criteria: Dependents of Presbyterian Church in America pastors and missionaries, new first-year or transfer students.

awards.name: Double Major & 5th Year Free
awards.criteria: First-year students who double major; Belhaven pays tuition if a fifth year is needed.

awards.name: Need Grant
awards.criteria: Based on financial need from the FAFSA.

awards.name: Mississippi Tuition Assistance Grant (MTAG)
awards.criteria: Mississippi residents; based on residency and academic achievement.

awards.name: Mississippi Eminent Scholars Grant (MESG)
awards.criteria: Mississippi residents; based on residency and academic achievement.

awards.name: Higher Education Legislative Plan (HELP)
awards.criteria: Mississippi residents; residency, academic achievement and financial need.

awards.name: Federal Pell Grant
awards.criteria: Based on financial need.

awards.name: Federal Work-Study
awards.criteria: Based on need and availability; full-time on-campus undergraduates.

awards.name: TEACH Grant
awards.criteria: Education majors who agree to teach in high-need fields or underserved areas; converts to a loan if service isn't met.

awards.name: Military tuition rate (active duty)
awards.criteria: Active-duty service members in online programs.

awards.name: Military tuition rate (veterans & spouses)
awards.criteria: Veterans and military spouses in online programs.

awards.name: First Responder Scholarship
awards.criteria: Law enforcement, firefighters, dispatchers and their spouses; most online undergraduate and graduate programs.

awards.name: Educator Discount
awards.criteria: Several online master's, specialist and doctoral education degrees.

awards.name: Nurse Discount (RN to BSN)
awards.criteria: Nursing courses in the RN to BSN program.

awards.name: Alumni Scholarship
awards.criteria: Belhaven graduates pursuing another Belhaven degree; cannot be combined with other discounts.

awards.name: Free Master's Degree (Belhaven Advantage)
awards.amount: Full tuition for an eligible online master's
awards.criteria: Qualifying traditional-campus Belhaven graduates.

awards.name: RUF Online Master's
awards.criteria: Reformed University Fellowship ministers, interns (second year+) and campus staff; 30- or 36-hour online master's.
